# Coherent states

Claims from wiphy.org; a natural next formalization target beside the existing harmonic-oscillator modules.

claims.name: coherentStates_starProduct
claims.statement: Coherent states are formulated within the star-product deformed harmonic oscillator algebra.

claims.name: coherentStates_generalizedUncertainty
claims.statement: The coherent states of the harmonic oscillator are constructed in the framework of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP).

sources.title: Coherent States in Gravitational Quantum Mechanics

claims.name: oscillator_twoPointFunctions_coherent
claims.statement: Two-point functions for the harmonic oscillator are computed for position eigenstates and coherent states.
